description: The Public Service Commission of the District of Columbia, in PEPRADR-2026-01, by Order No. 22894, dated June 30, 2026, accepted the proposed tariff filing of the Potomac Electric Power Company (“Pepco”) to amend its Residential Aid Discount Surcharge tariff as being in general conformity with the Commission’s tariff filing rules, but directed Pepco to resubmit the portion of its tariff filing replacing the ebridge link to its workpapers with a link that is more easily accessible and does not require registration.
text:
PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION OF THE DISTRICT OF COLUMBIA 
1325 G STREET, N.W., SUITE 800 
WASHINGTON, D.C. 20005 
ORDER 
June 30, 2026 
PEPRADR-2026-01, THE POTOMAC ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY’S RESIDENTIAL 
AID DISCOUNT COMPLIANCE REPORTS AND FILINGS, Order No. 22894 
1.
By this Order, the Public Service Commission of the District of Columbia
(“Commission”) accepts the proposed tariff filing of the Potomac Electric Power Company 
(“Pepco” or “Company”) to amend its Residential Aid Discount Surcharge (“RADS”) tariff as 
being in general conformity with the Commission’s tariff filing rules, but directs Pepco to resubmit 
the portion of its tariff filing replacing the ebridge link to its workpapers with a link that is more 
easily accessible and does not require registration. 
2.
On April 30, 2026, Pepco filed a RAD Surcharge update proposing to amend the
Company's current RADS tariff.1 The proposed tariff amendment is in general conformance with 
15 DCMR § 4901. However, the proposed tariff amendment filing provides access to the 
Company's workpapers through ebridge,2 which the Commission finds to be unnecessarily 
restrictive insofar as it requires users to register before accessing the workpapers. Accordingly, 
the Commission directs Pepco to resubmit its filing with a link to its workpapers in their native 
format (e.g., Excel) with formulas enabled that are freely and directly accessible without 
registration or other preconditions. 
THEREFORE, IT IS ORDERED THAT: 
3.
The Commission ACCEPTS the Potomac Electric Power Company’s proposed
tariff filing to amend its Residential Aid Discount Surcharge but postpones further action on the 
tariff filing until such time it conforms to the condition set forth in Paragraph 4, and 
4.
The Potomac Electric Power Company is directed to resubmit the part of its tariff
amendment, within thirty (30) days of the date of this Order, replacing the ebridge link to its 
workpapers with a direct, unencumbered link that does not require registration, and that provides 
access to the workpapers in their native format (e.g., Excel) with formulas enabled. 
A TRUE COPY: 
BY DIRECTION OF THE COMMISSION: 
CHIEF CLERK: 
BRINDA WESTBROOK-SEDGWICK
